edges.reason: Mining oak_log first orients the agent near trees, then they navigate to the stone cliff to mine iron_ore with the provided stone pickaxe
After mining oak_log near spawn, the agent explores outward to locate the distinct jungle_planks structure to the left

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining an oak_log block drops an oak_log item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_log in inventory (verified via sandbox screenshot). Oak logs can be mined with any tool or bare hands, and the provided stone pickaxe works fine. This is the most direct and reliable check for a mine task.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate toward and visually identify the jungle planks structure without needing to mine it. The target [-5, 1, 7] is the approximate center of the jungle planks hut (which spans X:-7 to -4, Y:0-3, Z:6-8 in spawn-relative coords). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the structure rather than just passing nearby while facing away.

Uses inventory_has with item 'raw_iron' because in Minecraft 1.17+, mining iron_ore with a stone pickaxe (mining level 1, which is provided in hotbar slot 1) drops raw_iron — NOT the ore block itself. The player starts with no raw_iron in inventory. This is the correct modern drop item, confirmed via wiki lookup. Using inventory_has is preferred for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

scene_description: A forest scene with three key features: (1) Oak tree with accessible logs near spawn at ~3,0,2, (2) A jungle planks hut structure at ~-7 to ~-4, y0-3, z6-8, and (3) A stone cliff face with exposed iron ore at ~8-10, y0-1, z-2 to -3. The player spawns with only a stone pickaxe (in default slot 1) which works for all mining tasks. Set in a natural forest biome.
task_text: First, mine an oak log from a nearby tree. Then explore to find the jungle planks structure. Finally, locate and mine iron ore from the exposed stone cliff using your stone pickaxe.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at origin facing south in forest biome. Oak tree at (3,0,2) — immediately visible ahead-right. Jungle planks hut at (-7 to -4, 0-3, 6-8) — left-rear, ~10 blocks. Stone cliff with iron ore at (8-10, -1 to 2, -2 to -5) — right-rear, ~9 blocks. Only stone pickaxe provided (slot 1, default) — works for all tasks. Natural biome trees supplement placed oak tree.
